descriptions.tsonnet_b36_ratio_800f12f0: Returns an elapsed-count ratio: a first global constant when the count is below the object's start (+44), a second global constant when the elapsed count exceeds the span length returned by a helper chain on the context pointer (+32), otherwise the elapsed count divided by the span length, both as signed integers converted to float. Field meanings are inferred. Division by a zero span and the constants' values have not been behaviorally tested.
